properties.inform: In addition to a speed limit of 5 knots within 300 metres of the coast, in this area speed is limited to 10 knots for all forms of motorised craft except for beach pleasure craft (see French sailing directions).

properties.inform: Navigation in the vicinity of Nice airport is restricted. Precise restrictions on circulation, anchorage, swimming, diving and nautical sports (kite surfing, parakiting) apply to each area. Other specific restrictions apply to pilotage (see French sailing directions).
properties.ninfom: La navigation autour de l'aéroport de Nice est réglementée. Les zones définies obéissent à des restrictions sur la navigation, le mouillage, la baignade, la plongée sous-marine, les sports nautiques (Kite, parachute...). Des règles sont aussi fixées pour le pilotage (voir Instructions Nautiques).
